sentences.text:
This application under section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime
No.319 of 2013, under section 498A, 304B I.P.C., and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Shahganj, District Agra.

2.  After arguing the matter at some length, Sri Mahendra Tripathi, counsel for the applicants prays for withdrawal of this application with liberty to the applicants to surrender before the concerned court and apply for regular bail.
3. In view of the above, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
